Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome data {#data}

Create records in a published class.

```text
apiome data [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`create`](#data-create).

## apiome data create {#data-create}

Create one record in a published class (POST /v1/data/{tenant}/records).

The record comes from --from-file, --stdin or --field; --field values are applied on top of the file or stdin object. It is checked against the class's JSON Schema before it is sent.

A record that does not match the schema exits 7 with one line per field; nothing is created.

--json prints the created record: record_id, class, class_schema_id and data.

```text
apiome data create [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--class` | text |  | yes | The class, e.g. billing/1.0.0/Charge (published version). |
| `--from-file` | path |  |  | JSON or YAML file holding the record. |
| `--stdin` | flag |  |  | Read the record (JSON or YAML) from stdin. |
| `--field` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Set one field: key=value, or key=:&lt;json&gt; to parse the value (repeatable). |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Validate against the class schema only; send nothing. |
| `--json` | flag |  |  | Print the created record as JSON (same as the global --json). |
